A transfer student who came to the main character’s school at the end of his first year, which made for strange timing. Rumors say she was forced to transfer out from her previous school in Tokyo after causing problems there.

Tardiness and leaving early are par for the course for her, and she gets put into protective custody often when people catch her roaming the city at night. She’s usually asleep during class because of that.
She seems distant, but she’s unexpectedly bright and cheery when you actually talk to her. She’s a carefree person, and people have a hard time dealing with her completely crazy behavior.

She acts unusually intimate with people, which often leads to misunderstandings. She frequently claims to have a secret, but she never tells what that is. Well-versed in knowledge specific to strange subcultures.
一年の終わりになってやってきた、季節外れの転校生。
東京の学校で問題を起こしたため、転校するハメになったともっぱらの噂。
遅刻早退は当たり前で、深夜徘徊で補導されることたびたび。
そのため、授業中は基本的に眠っている。
クールな外見に見えるが、話してみると意外と感情豊か。
気まぐれで突拍子もない行動で、人を振り回す気分屋。
人との距離感が異常など近く、それが誤解を生むこともしばしば。
秘密を抱えているとよく公言するが、それがなんなのか、決して教えてくれない。
妙なサブカル知識に明るい。

An upperclassman at the main character’s school, and a member of the same literature club as him. She’s popular among both boys and girls for her quiet demeanor and sense of refinement.
Her role in the literature club is solely to read, and she gives excellent feedback and criticism for the writing of other club members.

She knows a lot about a lot of things from all the reading she does, but that knowledge doesn’t necessarily translate to actual ability. Regardless, everyone around her considers her "a very capable" woman from her bearing and the feeling she gives off in general.
She herself just wants to be interacted with normally. She keeps a daily diary on an old-school social networking website.
主人公と同じ学校に通う上級生で、文藝部の先輩。
物静かな容姿と、凜とした佇まいで、男子女子問わず人気がある。
文藝部に所属してはいるが、自身は読み専門で部員たちの作品に的確な批評・寸評をしている。
ずっと本を読んでいるだけに、様々な知識を蓄えているが、知ってるだけで実践出来るわけではない。
だけど、彼女の物腰や纏う空気感から「出来る女」と周囲からは認識されている。
本人は「普通」に接して欲しいと思っている。
古いタイプのＳＮＳサイトで、毎日日記をつけている。

A girl in the same year as the main character at his school. She’s a blonde girl who’s half-American from her father’s side. Both of her parents have already passed away, and she currently lives alone at her maternal grandmother’s house.

She has high IQ, and is particularly skilled in regards to computers and network management. She doesn’t have much in the way of social ability due to being a shut-in that plays video games all day, and will often either say cringey things that a middle-schooler would say or speak like a highly intellectual adult.
She’s not one to really admit it, but she’s actually quite lonely, and longs for a warm family.
Her biological father is Paul Grey, founder and CEO of Citron company.

日本人の母とアメリカ人の父を持つ金髪のハーフ。
両親はすでに他界しており、母方の祖母の実家で一人暮らし。
高いＩＱを持ち、特にコンピュータ、ネットワーク関連に強い。
引きこもりでゲーム三昧のため対人能力が低く、中二的なイタイ言動や大人ぶった理知的なしゃべり方をすることも。
なかなか素直になれないが、実は寂しがり屋で、温かい家族に憧れている。

A professional shoujo manga author from Hakodate. She’s a comfy, happy, and fluffy girl who’s a bit of an airhead. She grew up going to all-girls’ schools, so she can’t speak with men particularly well, and isn’t very assertive.
She’s got a girly, imaginative way of thinking, and often ends up embarrassed from misunderstanding things.
She hasn’t had a popular series since her debut, and she’s troubled over how she only seems to get to do one-shots or short series.
函館出身のプロ少女漫画家。
ちょっぴり天然でほんわか明るく、ゆるふわな女の子。
ずっと女子校育ちだったため、男性とは緊張して上手く話せず、自己主張も苦手。
夢見がちの乙女脳で、よく勘違いしては恥ずかしい思いをしている。
デビュー作以降ヒット作に恵まれず、読み切りや短期連載ばかりなのが悩みの種。

Her thought process is mature for her age, and is knowledgeable and that’s about it. She yearns to be in love and tries to drag the main character around all over the place, calling those outings dates.

The competent head editor at the same publishing company that the main character works at. Involved with the publication of many popular novels, including the particularly well-known "Novel Yotsuba."

She’s a woman with a great figure who gushes mature charm. She gets along well with people, and her kind, radiant smile is notable. She was so focused on her career that by the time she realized it, she was past typical marrying age.
Her mother is currently pressuring her to find someone.

A beautiful female author who made her debut as a novelist when she was a university student.
Her maiden work, "Processor," won the Novel Yotsuba Newcomer Novelist Award.
It took the world by storm and has been made into a film, and her works after that have also all been hits.
Selfish and uninhibited. She has a carefree, does-whatever-she-pleases personality.
She makes a point to never sleep with the same man twice.

School Arc:

The main character. A second-year high school student who’s in the literature club. He just wants to sit back and read books through school... is what he tells people, but he secretly wants to write a novel. He has lots that he’s written without telling anyone else, but he has yet to complete it. He works part-time at "BIBLIO CAFE," a bookstore-cafe by the train station. He likes motorcycles, and just recently convinced his parents to let him buy one.
After Arc:

Now 25 years old. A beginner editor working at the smallish publishing company, Yotsuba Publishing. He tried to apply for the newcomer novelist awards while continuing with creative writing during his university years, but after being faced with the limits of his own ability, chose to move on to the path of an editor. He’s in charge of "Real Talk NOW," a weekly magazine aimed toward a blue-collar audience. He’s starting to lose zeal for his work because of the disparity between his expectations and reality, as well as the fact that he’s stuck in a rut for the novel he’s writing in his free time as a hobby.

A high-level-learning AI that Rein developed. A low-key master who loves country music from Colorado, where he was born and raised. He's a cat-like... something... that has tons of 'back-story' given to him, with an eye-patch that seals the power of his evil eye-- when he removes it, his Nidhogg blood awakens.
He's incredibly highly skilled, but these days he's just been Tsukiko's playmate, causing him to put himself down as a babysitter AI.
Seira who appears in the After Arc.

Seira’s very much become a high-school girl. She’s currently busy thinking about whether she should go study at a university after graduating. She's come back to Kanata and the two live together to some extent as she continues walking in the direction of her dreams.
